notes: Full animation polish pass — combat weight, hit stop, directional shake, art lunge, damage numbers, evolution shockwave, Legendary/Platinum presence.

items: Multi-deck slots — save up to 8 named custom decks and switch between them any time.
Trial deck picker — choose which of your custom decks to bring into each Trial before it starts.
Deck Manager screen — create, edit, duplicate, and delete deck slots all in one place.
Drag-to-attack — drag a unit card onto an enemy to attack instead of tapping to select.
Hit stop — every attack freezes for 0.04–0.07 s on impact before damage resolves, making hits feel heavier.
Directional screen shake — shake now pushes toward the point of impact then rebounds, scaled by rarity (Bronze: barely perceptible → Platinum: satisfying).
Art lunge — the card's artwork zooms and shifts inside the frame during the strike; the character looks like it's pressing forward.
Damage numbers redesigned — pop in large, spring-bounce to natural size, drift upward, fade smoothly. Heavy or rarity-scaled hits display in gold at a larger size.
Projectiles accelerate with cubic easing, brighten at 72% of travel, and burst larger on arrival.
Impact package: bright central flash + expanding shockwave ring added to every hit.
Idle animations locked during combat — breathing, float, and orbiting orbs pause cleanly while a card attacks or dies, then resume.
Buff flash — stat increases trigger a scale-pop and colored glow on the affected card with a floating stat label.
Healing particles, recovery sparkle burst, and relapse entry wisp added to matching game events.
Evolution shockwave — all four evolution tiers (Standard, Epic, Legendary, Platinum) fire an expanding ring on completion.
Legendary and Platinum followers now stand out in idle with larger orbiting dots, wider orbit radius, brighter halos, and rarity-scaled border glow.
Graphics quality levels (Low / Medium / High) gate spark counts, orb rendering, and ring VFX for performance.
Hope class — 10-card buff pass improving healing synergy, leader-heal triggers, and late-game power.
Deck copy limits tightened: Legendaries now cap at 2 copies per deck; Platinums cap at 1 copy.
Courage 'Never Quit' survive-buff (Never Quit, JD-023, JD-089, JD-146) now triggers correctly after a unit survives lethal damage.
Battle deck mode now correctly routes custom slot decks into the fight — no more falling back to the class prebuilt silently.
Art clipped inside card frame — Legendary float and parallax drift can no longer overflow the card border.

upcoming_events: More seasonal content and cards are in development — check back after future updates.
